newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil premiums ease.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil premiums ease.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.

Gasoline barges were steady but cargoes higher as crude bounced and supplies stayed more snug after recent arbitrage deals to the States. Naphtha was firmer with crude but high freight rates were still seen hamstringing physical deals.
Gas oil premiums slipped by around $1, more than erasing modest gains on IPE futures.
High sulphur fuel oil recovered. But fresh Venezuelan avails may exert pressure on February prices.
